verdict.rationale: Programmatic or bulk filing is a fair question for an employer payroll-tax service, so the axis applies. The pack shows no headless or CI automation path. No OpenAPI spec was found, the transactional portal host returned 403 at robots.txt, and enrollment relies on interactive email and phone/text verification. FSET and EFT are named only as payment/filing methods, with nothing describing them as an automatable interface.
